milestones.title: The Stored Login
milestones.joke: The usual way: a login secret in CI.
milestones.when: bao: AppRole login from a CI job (not wired: needs a `bao` source event `login`, method approle, entity/alias `ci`)

milestones.title: The Job's Own Identity
milestones.when: bao: JWT login from a CI job (not wired: needs a `bao` source event `login`, mount jwt-ci, role ci-main)

milestones.title: Other Branches Refused
milestones.when: bao: refused JWT login from a non-main branch (not wired: needs a `bao` event `login` with error, mount jwt-ci)

milestones.title: Retired the Stored Secret
milestones.when: shell: `curl -X DELETE .../actions/secrets/<name>` (exit 0; curl exits 0 on an HTTP error, so this proves the request, not the deletion)
